title: Things To Do in Queenstown | Activities | Official Website
facts: Destination Queenstown lists Lake Wakatipu, Queenstown Gardens, Arrowtown, Glenorchy and Gibbston as places to explore.
The official guide describes lake activities, walks, culture and nearby vineyards as different ways to visit the region.
The guide associates winter with skiing and the warmer months with hiking, biking and lake activities.
confidence: official-source; editorial review limited to listed stable facts
notes: Stable place and visitor-planning facts only. Prices, opening hours, event schedules and safety guarantees are deliberately omitted; consult operators for current conditions.
